description: 66 plausible resume/job pairs: 3 resume strengths for each of 22 job families, each scored against its OWN family's description. Cross-family pairs are excluded on purpose -- including them would make the bar 'better than a random pairing', which flatters every real application. Synthetic and small: this fixes the scale, not the ranking. No outcome labels exist and nothing in the scorer is fitted to these pairs.
